lines.trans: Denis, start playing, I think the inspector will come down right now.
You look sharp today.
Do I look like an old inspector?
I walk up, and the way he looks at me!
I even felt faint.
Nastya, what did he order?
Fillet of pigeon and the fish dish.
We will cook it right now, he will give us two stars!
I will do the cooking, and you give me clean knives.
Chef, why me?
Yes, you are right, I will wash the knives myself too.
Right now Daddy is going to make history!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'only', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Столько лет прошло, а ты все пользуешься этим!
examples.trans: So many years have passed, and you still use that line!

examples.text: Готовить буду только я!
examples.trans: Only I will do the cooking!

examples.text: Все наши гости получают только самое лучшее.
examples.trans: All our guests receive only the very best.
